'''The High Priest''' was a [[Lorrdian]] [[Gender|male]] who led the [[Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance]] and gave up his name as part of his [[Religion|faith's]] renouncement of individuality. His followers referred to him only with a keening wail of a certain pitch. The [[priest]] led his followers on a [[pilgrim]]age to [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] and spent [[time]] in the markets there shortly before the [[city]] was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] in [[1 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[File:HighPriestFace-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|The High Priest led a pilgrimage to Jedha City.]]
The High Priest was a [[Lorrdian]] [[Gender|male]] who led<ref name="Geektionary" /> the [[Religion|religious]] congregation known as the [[Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> As his faith called for the renouncement of all individuality, the [[priest]] willingly gave up his own name,<ref name="Geektionary" /> with his followers only referring to him using a keening wail of a specific pitch.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Due to the group's dogmatic vow of silence, moaning sounds of this sort were the only way the Brotherhood could communicate with the High Priest at all.<ref name="Geektionary" />

The High Priest led the Brotherhood,<ref name="Geektionary" /> including fellow Lorrdian [[Toshdor Ni]], on a [[pilgrim]]age to [[Jedha City]] on the sacred [[moon]] [[Jedha]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> he was lent against the wall of an alley in the [[city]] with another member of the Brotherhood when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] agents [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] walked past. He then moved from the alley into a market square and was then stood near two other Brotherhood members in the square when Erso first met the [[Guardians of the Whills|Guardian of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]]. As Erso and Andor then exited the square, they walked toward the priest before he passed them and moved back into the square. Soon after, the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] Jedha City using the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The High Priest took his faith's concealment of individuality to [[heart]] so strongly that he stripped himself of his name.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Equipment==
While on Jedha, the High Priest wore the [[Blue Gown of the Sullen Moon]] and the [[Lorrdian Cowl of Quiescence]], both of which were a matching [[Color|blue]] and yellow in color. He also carried a [[metal]]lic [[staff]] and wore brown [[Clothing|shoes]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The High Priest first appeared in the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="RO" /> which was released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref> Prior to the film's release, the character was revealed as part of a reel of promotional footage for ''Rogue One'' shown at [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration Europe]] on [[July 15]], 2016.<ref name="Celebration">{{SWYouTube|HUb_zpdyDpU|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story - Celebration Reel|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-celebration-reel}}</ref> The character's title was then provided in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="SW.com" />
